note_on_working_name: LakesideCabinHouse is a neutral asset name only. It does not create or rename a Fisherman Dad character, change rarity, or edit the Dad catalog.
description: A broad wooden fisherman's-cabin-style family home with an off-center gable ridge, a longer roof slope on one side, deep eaves, exposed end-frame beams, a wide lake-facing deck feeding an 8-wide pier, and a small private lake with a static rowboat. Deliberately different silhouette from RegularDadHouse_Final and OfficeDadHouse_Final.

units.note: 1 BU = 1 FBX centimetre = 1 Roblox stud, matching every other house asset.

orientation.asset_origin: (0, 0, 0) = ground level, centre of the property footprint
orientation.logical_to_blender: Blender_X = logical X; Blender_Y = logical D - 24 (D=0 front boundary -> Y=-24, D=48 lake boundary -> Y=+24); Blender_Z = logical H.

pier_stem.note: No rails on the stem -- full 8-stud clear width.

small_decorative: StoryProps furniture carcasses stay collidable; small props are in noncollide_objects
collision_hint.noncollide_note: All objects listed in noncollide_objects below are set CanCollide=false by apply_lakeside_cabin_house_colors.luau -- door leaves/hardware, window panes, shutters, mugs, books, reeds, the drawing/portraits, boots, rods, the toy boat, the rowboat's rim/interior/oar/rope, the bucket, and similar small/parked props.
collision_hint.water_flag_note: Lake_Water_Surface is a decorative visual plane (CanCollide=false); it is NOT a walkable floor and NOT a swim volume. Swimming/fall/NPC-in-water behavior is UNVERIFIED and not implemented here.
collision_hint.note: Blender has no Roblox collision data. Set CanCollide/CollisionFidelity in Studio after import; this is only a grouping hint.
